strings.zh: 未診斷異膚卻自行買來「保養 / 美白」(這是亞洲常見問題）
strings.en: Self-purchased for "skincare / whitening" without an AD diagnosis (a common Asian problem)

strings.zh: 已經連續每天擦類固醇超過 4-8 週
strings.en: Continuous daily steroid use exceeding 4–8 weeks

strings.zh: 「象牙皮膚」(elephant skin)— 皮膚變厚、皺、脫屑像砂紙
癢 → 抓 → 皮膚屏障破損
屏障破損 → 過敏原 / 細菌進入 → 釋放 IL-31、IL-4、IL-13 等發炎因子
strings.en: Barrier disruption → allergen / bacterial entry → release of IL-31, IL-4, IL-13 inflammatory mediators

strings.zh: 嚴重異膚伴隨多重食物過敏的小孩
strings.en: Children with severe AD plus multiple food allergies

strings.zh: 消費者以為「沒類固醇」會大方長期使用，結果用到比醫師處方更強的類固醇，反而更容易出現皮膚萎縮、戒斷
strings.en: Consumers believing they're "steroid-free" use these long-term and ironically end up with stronger steroid exposure than a physician would prescribe, making atrophy and withdrawal more likely

strings.zh: 重金屬（汞）會經皮膚吸收進入體內，造成腎、神經損傷
strings.en: Heavy metals (mercury) absorbed transdermally cause renal and neurological damage

strings.zh: 停用後皮膚大幅惡化，因為原本是被掩蓋而非治療
strings.en: Cessation leads to severe rebound because the underlying disease was masked, not treated

strings.zh: ≥ 6 月-5 歲：依體重 200-300 mg q4w
strings.en: ≥ 6 months to 5 years: weight-based 200–300 mg every 4 weeks

strings.zh: 6-11 歲(15-60 kg):300 mg loading + 300 mg 第 15 天 → 300 mg q4w;>60 kg 改 q2w
strings.en: 6–11 years (15–60 kg): 300 mg loading + 300 mg on day 15 → 300 mg q4w; >60 kg switches to q2w

strings.zh: 12-17 歲(<60 kg):400 mg loading → 200 mg q2w;>60 kg 600 mg → 300 mg q2w
strings.en: 12–17 years (<60 kg): 400 mg loading → 200 mg q2w; >60 kg 600 mg → 300 mg q2w

strings.zh: 成人:600 mg loading → 300 mg q2w
已核准合併症:中重度氣喘、CRSwNP、嗜酸性食道炎、結節性癢疹 — 一藥多病可同時受惠
strings.en: Approved comorbidities: moderate-to-severe asthma, CRSwNP, eosinophilic esophagitis, prurigo nodularis — one drug treats multiple conditions

strings.zh: 結核(IGRA + 胸部 X 光,3 個月內)、B / C 型肝炎、HIV、CBC + 淋巴球分類、肝腎功能、血脂、CPK
strings.en: TB screening (IGRA + chest X-ray within 3 months), HBV/HCV, HIV, CBC with differential, liver/renal function, lipid panel, CPK

strings.zh: 禁用閾值:ALC < 500/μL、ANC < 1000/μL、Hb < 8 g/dL
strings.en: Contraindication thresholds: ALC < 500/μL, ANC < 1000/μL, Hb < 8 g/dL

strings.zh: VTE 高風險史 → 禁用(class warning,源自 ORAL Surveillance)
strings.en: History of high VTE risk → contraindicated (class warning, derived from ORAL Surveillance)
